_meta.what: Which first-tier ★ piece each second-tier ★★/★★★ pair is made from. The English client renames four of them between tiers (Slayer -> Two Handed Sword, Wand -> Oak Wand, Short Spear -> Broken Blade Halberd, Hora -> Studded Knuckles), so the link cannot be read off the names.
_meta.how: Settled by the aegis resource names on divine-pride.net (tier-1 is <base>_RF, tier-2 is <base>_RFP1 / _RFP2: 600077 is Z_Slaye_RFP1, from 600074 Z_Slaye_RF -- NOT from 600070 Z_Bastard_Sword_RF, which a name-only match against the French guide first suggested; checked 25 Sep 2026). Then checked against the client: same weapon type, same required level, tier-2 base ATK never below tier-1, and the ids sit next to each other (530080 -> 530081/530082). Tokens are named after the tier-1 piece, except '★ Studded Knuckles Crafting Token', which is the token for ★ Hora -- the client's own link between those two names. app/star-chain.test.ts holds these checks.
_meta.clientMissing: The guide's ★★ pairs for Wire Whip (Entrave / Dispersion) and Lute (Chant / Résonance) have no item in our client yet, so those two chains stop at tier 1 here.
